title: Turn on playback controls and subtitles for demo videos
goal: supports manual playback and silent viewing of operation demonstrations through video and WebVTT track.
summary: device operation demonstration includes short beeps. The material and a WebVTT subtitle are ready and handed to the browser using the video attribute and track declaration.
tasks: Add controls to the existing video and retain the existing source and track addresses.
Set kind="captions", srclang="en", label="English", and default on the track.

example.code:
<video controls src="opening.webm">
  <track src="opening-en.vtt" kind="captions" srclang="en" label="English" default>
</video>
example.note: captions record conversations and meaningful sounds. Each subtitle in the vtt file specifies a start and end time.

hint: Set default on track and controls on video. Keep the cross-origin attribute so the browser can load the embedded captions.
